title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the pattern of the data points in the scatterplot. Consider how the function $$f(x)=x^2$$ might affect the shape of the data when applied. Does it seem like a quadratic relationship could fit the data?

title: Analyzing Quadratic Fit
text: If $$f(x)=x^2$$, what kind of curve would you expect the data to follow?

title: Checking for Symmetry
text: Consider whether the data points are symmetric around a vertical line. This can help determine if a quadratic function like $$f(x)=x^2$$ is appropriate.

title: Symmetry in Data
text: Do the data points appear symmetric around a vertical line?
